title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Centre College, from historic campus landmarks and modern study lounges to student-led weekend events and arts programming.

cards.title: Free Student Performance Tickets
cards.subtitle: World-class shows for zero dollars
cards.notes: Scan your student ID at the box office starting at 6:30 PM on show nights to claim a free ticket to regular series performances.
cards.short_summary: Centre students can attend high-profile concerts and theater productions at the Norton Center for free with a valid ID.
cards.evidence_claim: Regular series shows at the Norton Center are free to Centre students, with tickets available for pickup starting at 6:30 p.m. on performance nights.
cards.access_notes: Student tickets are limited and distributed on a first-come, first-served basis beginning 90 minutes before showtime.

cards.title: Study at the Doherty Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet research and social study bays
cards.notes: Access comfortable study areas and computer stations. The lobby often features rotating art exhibitions by students and professionals.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offers multiple floors of free study space, research resources, and quiet zones for all students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grace Doherty Library provides comfortable study areas, computer stations, and resources for students at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check the library website for current academic term hours. A Centre ID is required to check out materials.

cards.title: SAC Late-Night Weekend Fun
cards.subtitle: Free campus-wide social events
cards.notes: Join the Student Activities Council for free weekend events including carnivals, live concerts, and themed late-night gatherings.
cards.short_summary: The SAC organizes a variety of free social events throughout the year, focusing on inclusive late-night weekend entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Activities Council (SAC) plans and organizes fun and inclusive events for the campus community for free.
cards.access_notes: Events are typically held in the Roush Campus Center or on the campus lawn and are open to all current students.

cards.title: Workout at Sutcliffe Hall
cards.subtitle: Free student gym access
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access the cardio deck, weight rooms, and indoor track. Open late most nights during the semester.
cards.short_summary: Located within Sutcliffe Hall, the Buck Fitness Center provides free gym and fitness facilities for the Centre community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buck Fitness Center is open to Centre students, faculty, and staff with swipe card access at no additional cost.
cards.source_title: Sutcliffe Hall - Facilities - Centre College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Sunday, 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM for students with valid card swipe access.

cards.title: Visit the Historic Old Centre
cards.subtitle: The heart of campus history
cards.notes: Walk through the 1819 Greek Revival building that served as a Civil War hospital. The second-floor Welcome Center is open to visitors.
cards.short_summary: Old Centre is the college's signature historic building, offering a free look at the institution's 19th-century roots.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Centre is the first building of the College and houses the Admission Office reception area, which is open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The building is open during standard administrative business hours, typically 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Play Pool and Ping Pong
cards.subtitle: Free recreation in the student hub
cards.notes: Check out pool balls or ping pong paddles from the Information Desk for free. Limit play to 30 minutes if others are waiting.
cards.short_summary: The Campus Center game room offers free recreational equipment for students to use during building hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can check out pool and ping pong equipment from the Information Desk by leaving their Student ID.
cards.access_notes: Common areas are accessible to students 24 hours a day via card swipe; equipment checkout is available during desk hours.

cards.title: Collaborative Study at the CLC
cards.subtitle: Tech-savvy group work spaces
cards.notes: Located in Crounse Hall, this space offers free group study rooms and seminar spaces for collaborative projects.
cards.short_summary: The CLC provides modern, tech-equipped spaces for students to work together on academic projects at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centre Learning Commons includes innovative spaces for individual and group study and is open during library hours.
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor of the Grace Doherty Library; accessible during standard library operating hours.

cards.title: Explore the Science Greenhouse
cards.subtitle: A quiet botanical escape
cards.notes: Visit the greenhouse located within the Young Hall science complex to see diverse plant collections used for biology research.
cards.short_summary: Young Hall features a greenhouse that serves as both a research facility and a unique, free indoor space to visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated and expanded Young Hall includes a greenhouse as part of its science facilities.
cards.access_notes: Access is generally available during academic building hours; check with the Biology department for specific public viewing times.

cards.title: Disc Golf at Jackson Park
cards.subtitle: Free 9-hole PDGA course
cards.notes: Walk less than a mile from campus to play this 9-hole course. You can borrow discs for free from the Centre Recreation Office.
cards.short_summary: Henry Jackson Park offers a professional-grade disc golf course that is free for students and the local community.
cards.evidence_claim: Jackson Park offers a P.D.G.A. approved 9-hole course; discs can be obtained by contacting the Recreation Office.
cards.access_notes: The park is open to the public from dawn until dusk daily.

cards.title: Attend a Campus Convocation
cards.subtitle: Free lectures and cultural events
cards.notes: Attend designated convocation events for free to hear from guest speakers, authors, and performers while earning academic credit.
cards.short_summary: Convocations are free campus events that bring diverse perspectives to the student body through lectures and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Centre Convocations are free for students and provide an hour of convocation credit for attendance.
cards.access_notes: Check the official convocation calendar for dates and locations; most are held in Newlin Hall or Weisiger Theatre.
